title: Long-Horizon Language Model Reinforcement Learning via Progressive Point Matching
abstract: arXiv:2609.07303v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Current paradigms for training language models via reinforcement learning rely heavily on sparse outcome rewards. However, as we pursue tasks that require longer and more complicated trajectories, such strategies result in slow learning. Prior work has attempted to address this problem by rewarding partial progress; however, naive formulations are often biased and converge to suboptimal policies. We show that a simple and unbiased dense reward formulation, which we term progressive point matching, scales exponentially more efficiently to long-horizon tasks by rewarding partial progress on a segment level, both theoretically and empirically via synthetic environments. We then show how progressive point matching can be practically instantiated using a single reference trajectory per task. On extremely hard math reasoning problems, sparse outcome rewards cannot make any progress, whereas segment-level rewards enable improvements at larger t

translated_title: 基于渐进点匹配的长时程语言模型强化学习
translated_abstract: arXiv:2609.07303v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：当前通过强化学习训练语言模型的范式严重依赖稀疏的结果奖励。然而，当我们追求需要更长、更复杂轨迹的任务时，这类策略会导致学习速度缓慢。先前的工作尝试通过奖励部分进展来解决这一问题，但朴素的奖励设计往往存在偏差，并会收敛到次优策略。我们提出了一种简单且无偏的密集奖励方法，称之为渐进点匹配，该方法通过在片段级别奖励部分进展，在理论上和经验上（通过合成环境验证）均能以指数级更高的效率扩展到长时程任务。随后我们展示了如何利用每个任务仅需一条参考轨迹来实际实现渐进点匹配。在极其困难的数学推理问题上，稀疏结果奖励无法取得任何进展，而片段级奖励则能在更大的……
tldr: 该论文提出“渐进点匹配”——一种简单无偏的片段级密集奖励方法，仅需每个任务一条参考轨迹即可实现，使强化学习在稀疏奖励完全失效的长时程任务（如极难数学推理）上获得指数级效率提升。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes "progressive point matching," a simple and unbiased segment-level dense reward method that requires only one reference trajectory per task, enabling exponentially more efficient reinforcement learning on long-horizon tasks like extremely hard math reasoning where sparse outcome rewards fail entirely.
